items.title: Wonder opened a new Chelmsford location
items.description: Wonder held the grand opening for a new Chelmsford location on July 23, 2026. A newly opened food-service location can create near-term demand for recurring facility and operating vendors.

items.title: Spectrum Health Systems opened a new Lowell treatment facility
items.description: Spectrum Health Systems announced a newly renovated Lowell treatment center with inpatient, stabilization, and outpatient services. The facility operates at meaningful scale and may require ongoing facility-support vendors.

items.title: Eko's Bar & Grill is one of Lowell's newest restaurants
items.description: The City of Lowell highlighted Eko's Bar & Grill as one of the city's newest restaurants during an Open Lowell event. New restaurants can be useful prospects for recurring local services.

items.title: Greater Lowell Chamber has a new website launch scheduled for late August
items.description: The Greater Lowell Chamber says a brand-new website is scheduled to launch in late August. The core website project may already be awarded, but the public launch creates a possible adjacent need for content, analytics, SEO, integrations, or ongoing site support.
